title: Open Models Increase Pressure on Product Teams
summary: New open-weight models are making it easier for smaller teams to prototype AI features while keeping deployment costs visible.
highlights: Open models make local and private deployments easier to evaluate.

title: Newsrooms Experiment With AI-Assisted Research Desks
summary: Editorial teams are testing AI research desks that gather background links, compare claims, and prepare source briefs before writing begins.
highlights: The strongest use case is pre-writing research support.
Source traceability matters more than generated prose.
Public trust depends on clear editorial accountability.
